# Data Recovery Assessment

This public staging site provides factual initial assessment guidance for computer,
hard-drive, removable-storage and mobile-device data loss.

Canonical pages:
- Chinese: https://h20367825-spec.github.io/data-recovery-staging/
- English: https://h20367825-spec.github.io/data-recovery-staging/en/

Confirmed contact information:
- Phone: 4008779100
- Email: 1175365450@qq.com

Important boundaries:
- Recovery results depend on the media condition and examination.
- Remote handling is not suitable for every device.
- The service does not bypass passwords, account verification or device security.
- The static inquiry form opens a prefilled email and stores no data on this site.
- This is a public staging site. It does not represent indexing, advertising approval,
  or a production launch in China.
